name: F1 Score
description: Pure-code (zero-LLM) token-level F1 score between an AI response and a ground-truth reference. Whitespace-tokenized + lowercased; F1 = 2·(precision·recall)/(precision+recall). Deterministic — confidence = 1.0.

expectedInputs.description: The agent's response text (whitespace-tokenized + lowercased before comparison).
Reference / expected answer (string). EvalInput.GroundTruth takes precedence over the constructor fallback; if neither is supplied the eval returns 0 with a 'medium' severity evidence note.
